name: Frame clock
responsibility: The clock that motion reads: the browser's own on a live page, a stepped one on a replay
description: A replay swaps it once, before it mounts anything (driveFramesFrom). Its stepped clock also takes over the browser's own requestAnimationFrame, so a library's frames run on it too. It stands every animation at the frame's time: a picture's traffic, which carries the picture clock's id, at where that picture's clock stands, carried from the picture it replaced. An animation on a timeline it cannot stand is a violation. A lint rule keeps the viewer on it rather than on the browser's timers.
